header.label: OpenAEC Ecosystem
header.desc: All OpenAEC tools communicate in IFCX. We add all the namespaces needed to store the complete building model in IFCX ourselves.

why.title: Why IFCX?
why.p1: IFCX is the next generation of the IFC data format. Where classic IFC (IFC2x3, IFC4) uses a fixed schema, IFCX offers a flexible, extensible model based on namespaces. This makes it possible to add domain-specific information without modifying the core schema.
why.p2: For the OpenAEC Foundation, IFCX is the logical choice: it is open, extensible and aligns with our vision that the entire AEC ecosystem should run on open standards.

universal.title: IFCX as universal language
universal.desc: Within the OpenAEC ecosystem, IFCX is the central data format. Every tool — from cost estimation to validation, from 2D drawings to 3D viewers — reads and writes IFCX. This means data flows seamlessly between all parts of the AEC chain, without conversion or data loss.

civil.title: IFC 4.3: from buildings to infrastructure
civil.desc: IFCX builds on IFC 4.3, which supports not only buildings but full civil infrastructure. This means OpenAEC covers residential and commercial buildings, as well as roads, bridges, tunnels, railways, water infrastructure and marine facilities.

list.building: IfcBuilding — buildings (residential/commercial): homes, offices, schools, hospitals
list.road: IfcRoad — roads, intersections, roundabouts, cycle paths
list.rail: IfcRail — railways, stations, platforms, switches
list.bridge: IfcBridge — bridges, viaducts, fly-overs
list.tunnel: IfcTunnel — tunnels (road, rail, pipeline)
list.marine: IfcMarineFacility — ports, locks, quay walls, dikes

model.title: Everything in one model
model.desc: We store everything in IFC. Not just the geometry, but all data that has any relationship with the BIM model is stored in this format:

standards.title: Standards
standards.desc: Dutch Building Decree, Eurocode, NL BIM Basis ILS and other regulations directly in the model

formulas.title: Formulas & calculations
formulas.desc: Structural calculations, energy calculations and sizing formulas

assumptions.title: Design basis
assumptions.desc: Project assumptions, design decisions and programme of requirements

reports.title: Reports
reports.desc: Inspection reports, validation reports and advisory reports

photos.title: Photos
photos.desc: Site photos, progress images and survey photos linked to elements

signatures.title: Signatures
signatures.desc: Digital signatures for approvals, handovers and sign-offs

drawings.title: Drawings
drawings.desc: 2D drawings, detail drawings and working drawings as part of the model

physics.title: Building physics data
physics.desc: Thermal properties, acoustics, daylight and moisture behavior

quotes.title: Quotes & estimates
quotes.desc: Cost estimates, quotes, quantities and unit prices

management.title: Facility management data
management.desc: Maintenance schedules, warranties, installation data and management information

tools.title: Tools that speak IFCX
tools.desc: All tools in the OpenAEC ecosystem are built around IFCX as the central format:

items.calc: Reads IFCX quantities, writes cost data back as the openaec:cost namespace
items.twod: Generates 2D drawings directly from IFCX geometry
items.pdf: Produces technical documents based on IFCX model data
items.energy: Calculates energy performance from the openaec:energy namespace
items.planner: Links planning to IFCX elements for 4D visualization
items.pointcloud: Compares point cloud data with IFCX models for as-built verification
items.field: Logs field inspections linked to IFCX elements
items.monty: Visualizes IFCX models including all custom namespaces
items.validator: Validates IFCX models against IDS specifications and Dutch standards

standard.title: Open standard
standard.p1: All OpenAEC namespaces are published openly and are free to use under an open license. We work together with buildingSMART and the Dutch BIM community to align our namespaces with international standards.
standard.p2: By developing and maintaining all necessary namespaces ourselves, we ensure that IFCX can actually contain a complete building model — from first sketch to handover and management.
